lead_raw_text:
The structure of SmCdPd crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Sm4 Cd4 Pd4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Cd centers with 12 geometric neighbors (4 Cd, 4 Pd, 4 Sm), Pd centers with 9 neighbors (4 Cd, 5 Sm), and Sm centers with 15 neighbors (8 Cd, 4 Pd, 3 Sm). The resulting periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and face-sharing between Cd and Pd polyhedra, corner-sharing between Cd and Sm polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Cd polyhedra.
